metadata.title: Commercial Cleaning Operations Platform Residuality Stress Test
metadata.description: How the zvoove Clean platform must change under wage shocks, labour shortage, client demand for proof, acquisitions and technology shifts.
metadata.naiveArchitecture: Each brand keeps its own database and app; quotes use fixed performance figures; plans are fixed weekly frequencies; attendance and audits are exported to payroll and clients as files.
metadata.residualArchitecture: Shared object and specification register, versioned tariffs used by calculation, planning and payroll, attendance events feeding payroll and client proof, a ticket and audit loop visible to clients, sensor-triggered tasks, and bridges that let brands coexist on shared tenancy.

stressors.name: A large collective-agreement or minimum-wage increase lands mid-contract
stressors.detection: Tariff negotiations, government minimum-wage decisions, rising hour costs per object.
stressors.attractor: Fixed-price contracts turn loss-making overnight; payroll and prices must change on the same date.
stressors.businessReaction: Release tariffs before effective dates, flag contracts without indexation and generate price-adjustment letters.
stressors.residue: Versioned tariffs shared by calculation, payroll and invoicing, with contract indexation rules.

stressors.name: Cleaners become impossible to hire
stressors.detection: Rising vacancies, sickness rates and turnover; uncovered visits.
stressors.attractor: Plans cannot be staffed; managers spend the day on the phone.
stressors.businessReaction: Invest in multilingual app, substitution offers and demand-driven cleaning that uses fewer hours better.
stressors.residue: Substitution and sensor-based task generation as first-class planning inputs.

stressors.name: Clients demand digital proof before paying
stressors.detection: Tenders requiring attendance proof and audit data; disputed invoices.
stressors.attractor: Invoices without proof are contested; suppliers without data lose tenders.
stressors.businessReaction: Make presence proof, checklists and audits visible in a client portal and attach them to invoices.
stressors.residue: Proof data linked to invoices and contracts.

media.alt: Illustration of the residuality stressor 'Clients demand digital proof before paying', showing its signal, attractor, business response, and surviving residue.

stressors.name: Six brands diverge instead of converging
stressors.detection: Duplicate features, parallel roadmaps, customers asking which product to buy.
stressors.attractor: Integration cost rises and enterprise customers lose trust.
stressors.businessReaction: Define shared bricks (attendance, payroll, audits) and bridges; keep brand front-ends where customers value them.

media.title: Residuality stressor illustration: Six brands diverge instead of converging
media.alt: Illustration of the residuality stressor 'Six brands diverge instead of converging', showing its signal, attractor, business response, and surviving residue.

stressors.name: Cleaning robots take over floor care in large objects
stressors.detection: Robot vendors in tenders; clients asking for hybrid human-robot service.
stressors.attractor: Hours and plans must include machines; calculation and billing change.
stressors.businessReaction: Model robots as resources in plans and calculation and ingest their run data as proof.
stressors.residue: Resource model that is not only people; device data as proof.
